criteria.help: The criteria in input order, addressed by their number from 0. At most 15; a comparison needs at least 3.

matrix.help: The comparison matrix: matrix[i][j] says how criterion i fared against criterion j — 1 won, 0.5 tied, 0 lost. Empty while no comparison is running; the diagonal has no meaning.

pairs.help: The shuffled order of the pairs to decide, each entry the two criterion numbers. Empty while no comparison is running; with n criteria there are n·(n−1)/2 pairs. Every start of the comparison shuffles a new order.

currentPair.help: How many pairs are already decided — and therefore the index of the next one in pairs. Equal to the length of pairs means finished. chooseLeft, chooseRight and tieCurrent decide the pending pair and count on.

viewPhase.help: The displayed tab: Criteria, Comparison or Result. Comparison is only reachable while a comparison is running, Result only once it is finished; every change to the criteria leads back to Criteria.

result.help: The evaluation: points per criterion and ranking, each figure described individually under keys; null until all pairs are decided.

addCriterion.help: Appends a criterion to the list and returns its number, counted from 0. A running or finished comparison becomes invalid: matrix, pair order and progress go back to empty, and the view shows the criteria again.

params.text: The name of the criterion; surrounding whitespace is dropped. Empty text, a name that is already in the list and a criterion beyond the maximum of 15 are rejected.
params.command: The command as one object with text.

removeCriterion.help: Removes a criterion. A running or finished comparison becomes invalid: matrix, pair order and progress go back to empty, and the view shows the criteria again.

params.i: The number of the criterion, counted from 0. A number that names no criterion is rejected.
params.command: The command as one object with i.

startComparison.help: Starts the comparison: forms every pair of the criteria in shuffled order and switches to the Comparison tab. With fewer than three criteria the start is rejected.

params.command: The command as an empty object; it takes no arguments.

chooseLeft.help: Decides the pending pair for the left criterion (left arrow key): it gets 1 point, the other 0. Then the next pair follows; after the last one the view switches to the Result tab. While no comparison is running — before the start or once all pairs are decided — the decision is rejected.

params.command: The command as an empty object; it takes no arguments.

chooseRight.help: Decides the pending pair for the right criterion (right arrow key): it gets 1 point, the other 0. Then the next pair follows; after the last one the view switches to the Result tab. While no comparison is running — before the start or once all pairs are decided — the decision is rejected.

params.command: The command as an empty object; it takes no arguments.

tieCurrent.help: Rates the pending pair as equally important (space bar): both criteria get 0.5 points. Then the next pair follows; after the last one the view switches to the Result tab. While no comparison is running — before the start or once all pairs are decided — the decision is rejected.

params.command: The command as an empty object; it takes no arguments.

cycleCell.help: Advances the rating of a matrix cell by one step: 0 to 0.5, 0.5 to 1, 1 back to 0. The opposite cell travels along. On the diagonal — a criterion against itself — and while no comparison has been started the change is rejected.

params.i: The number of the row's criterion, counted from 0. A number that names no criterion is rejected.
params.j: The number of the column's criterion, counted from 0. A number that names no criterion, and the same number as i, are rejected.
params.command: The command as one object with i and j.

Result.scores: The points per criterion, in the order of the criteria list — the Σ column of the comparison matrix. Each comparison gives 1 point for a win, 0.5 for equally important and 0 for a loss; the points are the sum of a matrix row without the diagonal. With n criteria at most n − 1 points are possible, and all points together add up to n·(n − 1)/2, the number of pairs.
Result.maxScore: The highest score reached. The longest bar in the ranking belongs to it; every other bar is shorter in proportion of its points to it.
Result.ranking: The ranking: all criteria in descending order of points. With equal points the order of the criteria list is kept; places 1 to 3 are highlighted in colour.

RankEntry.name: The name of the criterion as it appears in the criteria list.
RankEntry.score: The points of the criterion: 1 per comparison won, 0.5 per equally important one, 0 per comparison lost. The ranking shows them with one decimal place.
RankEntry.idx: The number of the criterion in the criteria list, counted from 0 — the same number as the row and column of the comparison matrix.
